subject: [PATCH 2/4] kernfs: Prepare directory revisions for lockless reads

2026-08-21.patch_summary: This patch prepares the directory revisions in the Linux kernel's kernfs subsystem for lockless reads by annotating accesses to parent directory generations and revision updates with READ_ONCE() and WRITE_ONCE(). This allows the comparison of directory revisions to safely move outside the kernfs_rwsem semaphore, improving performance. The writer contract in kernfs_inc_rev() is also asserted to ensure that revision updates remain serialized.
